task_description: Fix a MEAN stack Alumni Portal from prototype to deployable product. Critical bugs: mentorship/mentor routes missing authenticate middleware (req.user always undefined); Notification.create missing title field; Mentorship.create missing request field; User model has firstName/lastName but controllers populate 'name'; dashboard response shape mismatch; frontend status case mismatch (PENDING vs pending); auth guard race condition on refresh. Plus build missing Events, Opportunities, Messages UI components.
